mapper.select: WITH MOVE_INFO AS( SELECT LOT_FAB, FAB, LOT_ID, WAFER_QTY, PRODSPEC_ID, OPE_NO, OPE_CATEGORY, SHIFT_DATE FROM ODS.V_MOVE_HISTORY@A1PDW WHERE NENG_FLAG = 1 AND MOVE_FLAG = 1 AND SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE -7.5 / 24, 'YYYYMMDD') ) ,PROCESS_LOT_INFO AS( SELECT FAB LOT_FAB,LOCATION FAB,LOT_ID,WAFER_QTY,PRODSPEC_ID,OPE_NO,'Processing'OPE_CATEGORY,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD')SHIFT_DATE FROM ODS.V_LOT@A1PDW WHERE LOT_INV_STATE = 'OnFloor' AND NENG_FLAG =1 AND PW_FLAG =1 AND LOT_PROC_STATE = 'Processing' ) ,MOVE_TARGET_INFO AS( SELECT LOCATION LOT_FAB,'N1A1'LOCATION ,TECH ,PRODG1,OPE_NO,MOVE_TARGET,END_DATE,MODULE FROM RTD.V_RTD_MOVE_TARGET_SHOW_NEW@A1PDW WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND TO_DATE(END_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD')>= TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24) AND LOCATION IN('N1A1','ALL') AND MOVE_TARGET >0 UNION ALL SELECT LOCATION LOT_FAB,'N1A3'LOCATION ,TECH ,PRODG1,OPE_NO,MOVE_TARGET,END_DATE,MODULE FROM RTD.V_RTD_MOVE_TARGET_SHOW_NEW@A3PDW WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND TO_DATE(END_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD')>= TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24) AND LOCATION IN('N1A1') AND MOVE_TARGET >0 ) ,ACT_MOVE_PRODG AS( SELECT LOCATION,LOT_FAB,TECH,PRODG1,OPE_NO,SUM(WAFER_QTY)MOVE FROM( SELECT D.PRODG1,D.TECH,D.LOT_FAB ,D.LOCATION,D.OPE_NO,A.WAFER_QTY FROM MOVE_INFO A LEFT JOIN ODS.WP_PRODUCT@A1PDW B ON A.PRODSPEC_ID = B.PRODSPEC_ID LEFT JOIN PWEB.PRODUCT_TECH_INFO@A1PDW C ON B.PRODG1 = C.PRODG1 JOIN MOVE_TARGET_INFO D ON C.GROUP_TECH = D.TECH AND B.PRODG1 = D.PRODG1 AND A.OPE_NO = D.OPE_NO AND A.LOT_FAB LIKE REPLACE(D.LOT_FAB,'ALL','%')AND A.FAB = D.LOCATION )GROUP BY LOCATION,LOT_FAB,TECH,PRODG1,OPE_NO ),ACT_MOVE_TECH AS( SELECT LOCATION,LOT_FAB,TECH,PRODG1,OPE_NO,SUM(WAFER_QTY)MOVE FROM( SELECT D.PRODG1,D.TECH,D.LOT_FAB ,D.LOCATION,D.OPE_NO,A.WAFER_QTY FROM MOVE_INFO A LEFT JOIN ODS.WP_PRODUCT@A1PDW B ON A.PRODSPEC_ID = B.PRODSPEC_ID LEFT JOIN PWEB.PRODUCT_TECH_INFO@A1PDW C ON B.PRODG1 = C.PRODG1 JOIN MOVE_TARGET_INFO D ON C.GROUP_TECH = D.TECH AND D.PRODG1 = '*' AND A.OPE_NO = D.OPE_NO AND A.LOT_FAB LIKE REPLACE(D.LOT_FAB,'ALL','%') AND A.FAB = D.LOCATION )GROUP BY LOCATION,LOT_FAB,TECH,PRODG1,OPE_NO ),ACT_PROCESS_TECH AS( SELECT LOCATION,LOT_FAB,TECH,PRODG1,OPE_NO,SUM(WAFER_QTY)PROCESS_QTY FROM( SELECT D.PRODG1,D.TECH,D.LOT_FAB ,D.LOCATION,D.OPE_NO,A.WAFER_QTY FROM PROCESS_LOT_INFO A LEFT JOIN ODS.WP_PRODUCT@A1PDW B ON A.PRODSPEC_ID = B.PRODSPEC_ID LEFT JOIN PWEB.PRODUCT_TECH_INFO@A1PDW C ON B.PRODG1 = C.PRODG1 JOIN MOVE_TARGET_INFO D ON C.GROUP_TECH = D.TECH AND D.PRODG1 = '*' AND A.OPE_NO = D.OPE_NO AND A.LOT_FAB LIKE REPLACE(D.LOT_FAB,'ALL','%') AND A.FAB = D.LOCATION )GROUP BY LOCATION,LOT_FAB,TECH,PRODG1,OPE_NO ) SELECT LOT_FAB,LOCATION,TECH,PRODG1,OPE_NO,MOVE_TARGET,END_DATE,MODULE,DTH_MOVE,DTH_TARGET,NVL(PROCESS_QTY,0)PROCESS_QTY ,FLOOR(DTH_MOVE *100/DTH_TARGET) MOVE_RATE FROM( SELECT A.LOT_FAB,A.LOCATION,A.TECH,A.PRODG1,A.OPE_NO,A.MOVE_TARGET,A.END_DATE,A.MODULE,NVL(NVL(B.MOVE,C.MOVE),0) DTH_MOVE ,CEIL((SYSDATE-(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24)+7.5/24)) * A.MOVE_TARGET) DTH_TARGET ,D.PROCESS_QTY FROM MOVE_TARGET_INFO A LEFT JOIN ACT_MOVE_PRODG B ON A.LOCATION = B.LOCATION AND A.LOT_FAB = B.LOT_FAB AND A.TECH = B.TECH AND A.PRODG1 = B.PRODG1 AND A.OPE_NO = B.OPE_NO LEFT JOIN ACT_MOVE_TECH C ON A.LOCATION = C.LOCATION AND A.LOT_FAB = C.LOT_FAB AND A.TECH = C.TECH AND A.PRODG1 = C.PRODG1 AND A.OPE_NO = C.OPE_NO LEFT JOIN ACT_PROCESS_TECH D ON A.LOCATION = D.LOCATION AND A.LOT_FAB = D.LOT_FAB AND A.TECH = D.TECH AND A.PRODG1 = D.PRODG1 AND A.OPE_NO = D.OPE_NO ) ORDER BY DTH_MOVE/DTH_TARGET
